ontology.geologicalResource: Not supplied by this scenario dataset; runtime derives only a clearly-marked simulation layer when needed.
ontology.technicallyRecoverable: Runtime-derived simulation quantity above geologicalResource when the scenario baseline requires an accounting bridge.
ontology.economicallyRecoverable: Runtime-derived simulation quantity before the final extractable reserve baseline.
ontology.extractableReserve: The per-site scenario quantity stored in reserve.quantity and consumed by extraction.
